description: This file defines the 'Api' class within the Opencart system, specifically for user API-related data operations. It includes methods to retrieve API details by username, fetch associated IP addresses, and log API call history.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A model class providing methods to interact with user API data, including retrieval and logging functionalities.

methods.name: getApiByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves API information from the database for a given username.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Fetches IP records associated with a specific API ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Logs a new API call history record into the database.
